name: My evil magician boss suddenly loves me?!
source: Mature dating sim with engaging gameplay! Take on a role of magic smithery manager. Explore dungeons, gather resources and forge weapons for sale. Make your boss fall for you and spoil her to bits by gifting her various outfits (so you can take them off later). Begin your adventure now!
